Stock Market Opening Bell: Sensex Surges 0.73%, Nifty 50 Rises 0.64%
Stock Market Opening: The Sensex rose 0.73% to 78,677.56, while Nifty 50 surged 0.64% to 24385.20 level.
Republic Business- 2 min read
Stock Market Opening Bell: The Indian benchmark stock market indices Nifty 50, and Sensex witnessed a gap up opening on Thursday, April 16, after rising hopes pinned to a possible de-escalation in the Middle East after the second round of US-Iran peace talks.
The Sensex rose 0.73% to 78,677.56, while Nifty 50 surged 0.64% to 24385.20 level.
The trends on Gift Nifty signalled a positive opening for the Indian benchmark indices. Gift Nifty was trading nearly 24,346 mark, a premium of over 97 points over the previous close of Nifty futures.
On Wednesday, the Indian stock market closed sharply higher, with the benchmark Nifty 50 ending above 24,200 level.
